title: Bud Hopkins videotaped on UFOs dragging us into 21st-century science

tellings.quote: having a recording of him from 1987 or something. I videotaped him for a documentary and he said eufology or UFOs are are dragging us kicking and screaming into the science of the 21st century

plain: Around 1987, Budd Hopkins, a well-known researcher of alien abduction reports, said on camera that UFOs are "dragging us kicking and screaming into the science of the 21st century." The writer Greg Bishop tells Michels he filmed Hopkins saying it himself, for a documentary. It is a claim that the subject would force science into new territory.
